entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 3 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de tu llegada y tener al menos 3 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 3 blank pages.

entry.en: Make sure you get your passport stamped on entry.
entry.es: Asegúrate de que sellen tu pasaporte al entrar.
entry.quote: Make sure you get your passport stamped.

entry.en: You must carry an original or certified copy of the full birth certificate of any child aged 17 or under when entering or leaving.
entry.es: Debes llevar el original o una copia certificada del certificado de nacimiento completo de cualquier menor de 17 años o menos al entrar o salir.
entry.quote: You must have an original or certified copy of the full birth certificate of any child aged 17 or under when you enter or leave the country.

entry.en: A parent who is not present must sign an affidavit consenting to the child's travel.
entry.es: El progenitor que no esté presente debe firmar una declaración jurada que autorice el viaje del menor.
entry.quote: Any parent not present must sign an affidavit giving their consent for the child to travel.

entry.en: You must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Foreign or local cash worth 10,000 Botswana pula or more must be declared.
entry.es: El efectivo extranjero o local por valor de 10.000 pulas de Botsuana o más debe declararse.
entry.quote: Declare foreign or local cash currency if the value is 10,000 Botswana pula or more.

safety.en: Attacks on tourists are rare, but violent crime is increasing, particularly in Gaborone, Francistown and Maun.
safety.es: Los ataques a turistas son raros, pero el crimen violento va en aumento, sobre todo en Gaborone, Francistown y Maun.
safety.quote: violent crime is increasing particularly in the major towns of Gaborone, Francistown and Maun.

safety.en: Criminals may target cars waiting at traffic lights.
safety.es: Los delincuentes pueden atacar coches que esperan en los semáforos.
safety.quote: Criminals may target cars waiting at traffic lights.

safety.en: Women should take care when walking and avoid walking alone at night.
safety.es: Las mujeres deben tener cuidado al caminar y evitar andar solas de noche.
safety.quote: women should take care when walking and avoid walking alone at night.

safety.en: Driving outside major urban areas can be dangerous due to stray wildlife and livestock, especially at night.
safety.es: Conducir fuera de las zonas urbanas importantes puede ser peligroso por la fauna y el ganado sueltos, sobre todo de noche.
safety.quote: driving outside the major urban areas can be dangerous due to stray wildlife and livestock.

safety.en: Do not bathe in rivers and lakes, as you could be attacked by wild animals and risk water-borne diseases.
safety.es: No te bañes en ríos ni lagos: podrías sufrir ataques de animales salvajes y contraer enfermedades transmitidas por el agua.
safety.quote: Do not bathe in rivers and lakes. You could be attacked by wild animals and you risk catching water-borne diseases.

safety.en: The rainy season runs from November to March, bringing heavy rainfall and a risk of flash flooding.
safety.es: La temporada de lluvias va de noviembre a marzo y trae fuertes precipitaciones y riesgo de inundaciones repentinas.
safety.quote: Botswana’s rainy season, runs from November to March, bringing heavy rainfalls and risk of flash flooding.

health.en: Call 997 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llama al 997 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 997 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Malaria is a health risk and was reported in April 2025 to have spread to areas where it is not usually present.
health.es: La malaria es un riesgo de salud y en abril de 2025 se informó de que se había extendido a zonas donde normalmente no está presente.
health.quote: malaria, which is reported in April 2025 to have spread to areas where it is not usually present

health.en: Healthcare is usually good in major towns, but medical facilities and communications are limited in rural areas.
health.es: La atención médica suele ser buena en las ciudades principales, pero las instalaciones y comunicaciones son limitadas en zonas rurales.
health.quote: Healthcare in Botswana is usually good in major towns, but medical facilities and communications are limited in rural areas.

health.en: Private hospitals will not treat you unless you can pay, and the cost may be high.
health.es: Los hospitales privados no te atenderán si no puedes pagar, y el coste puede ser alto.
health.quote: Private hospitals will not treat you unless you can pay, and the cost may be high.

health.en: Tap water in urban areas is chlorinated and drunk by locals, but short-term visitors should still drink bottled water.
health.es: El agua del grifo en zonas urbanas está clorada y la bebe la población local, pero los visitantes de corta estancia deberían beber agua embotellada.
health.quote: Water in urban and semi-urban areas is chlorinated, and is drunk from the tap by the local population.  Still, short term visitors should drink bottled water to avoid traveller's diarrhoea.

health.en: If you camp or walk in the bush, take precautions to avoid tick bites, which can cause several dangerous diseases.
health.es: Si acampas o caminas por el monte, toma precauciones contra las picaduras de garrapata, que pueden causar varias enfermedades peligrosas.
health.quote: If you intend to camp or walk in the bush, take precautions to avoid tick bites, as they can cause several dangerous diseases.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Botswana are 997 for ambulance, 998 for fire and 999 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Botsuana son el 997 para ambulancia, el 998 para bomberos y el 999 para policía.

getting_in.en: Sir Seretse Khama International Airport (GBE) is Botswana's main airport, roughly 15 km north of downtown Gaborone.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Sir Seretse Khama (GBE) es el principal de Botsuana, a unos 15 km al norte del centro de Gaborone.
getting_in.quote: Botswana's main airport is Sir Seretse Khama International Airport (GBE IATA) which is located roughly 15 kilometres (9 mi) north of downtown Gaborone

getting_in.en: The airport in Maun can also be reached via Johannesburg, Cape Town or Gaborone.
getting_in.es: Al aeropuerto de Maun también se llega vía Johannesburgo, Ciudad del Cabo o Gaborone.
getting_in.quote: The airport in Maun can also be reached via Johannesburg, Cape Town, or Gaborone

getting_in.en: Trains from South Africa have been withdrawn since 1999.
getting_in.es: Los trenes desde Sudáfrica están suprimidos desde 1999.
getting_in.quote: Trains from South Africa have been withdrawn since 1999.

getting_in.en: Possibly the busiest border crossing from South Africa is Kopfontein/Tlokweng.
getting_in.es: Posiblemente el paso fronterizo más concurrido desde Sudáfrica sea Kopfontein/Tlokweng.
getting_in.quote: Possibly the busiest border crossing from South Africa is the Kopfontein/Tlokweng border crossing

getting_in.en: There is a regular bus service from Johannesburg to Gaborone, which takes six hours.
getting_in.es: Hay un servicio regular de autobús de Johannesburgo a Gaborone que dura seis horas.
getting_in.quote: There is regular bus service from Johannesburg to Gaborone, which takes six hours.

getting_around.en: Taxis are the most common way to travel, and they can only travel on designated routes.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son el medio de transporte más común y solo pueden circular por rutas designadas.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are the most common way to travel; the taxis can only travel on designated routes

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left in right-hand drive vehicles.
getting_around.es: Se circula por la izquierda en vehículos con el volante a la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Traffic is on the left in right-hand drive vehicles

getting_around.en: There are no signposts in rural areas, so independent travellers are advised to use a GPS device.
getting_around.es: No hay señales en las zonas rurales, por lo que se aconseja a los viajeros independientes usar GPS.
getting_around.quote: There are no signposts in rural areas, so independent travellers are advised to use a GPS device.

getting_around.en: It is advisable to arrive at the bus station early, as buses fill up quickly.
getting_around.es: Conviene llegar temprano a la estación de autobuses, porque se llenan rápido.
getting_around.quote: It is advisable to arrive at the bus station quite early, as the buses do fill up quickly

getting_around.en: Passenger trains stopped operating during Covid and have not been reintroduced yet.
getting_around.es: Los trenes de pasajeros dejaron de funcionar durante el Covid y aún no se han reintroducido.
getting_around.quote: Passenger trains stopped operating during Covid and have not been reintroduced yet.

getting_around.en: The Trans-Kalahari Highway is newly paved and easily drivable with a 2-wheel drive.
getting_around.es: La carretera Trans-Kalahari está recién asfaltada y se puede recorrer fácilmente con tracción en dos ruedas.
getting_around.quote: The Trans-Kalahari Highway is an old cattle route, now newly paved and easily drivable with a 2-wheel drive.

money.en: Botswana's currency is the pula (BWP), subdivided into 100 thebe.
money.es: La moneda de Botsuana es el pula (BWP), dividido en 100 thebe.
money.quote: Botswana's currency is the pula, denoted by the symbol "P" (ISO 4217 code: BWP). It is subdivided into 100 thebe.

money.en: Banknotes are issued in denominations of P10, 20, 50, 100 and 200.
money.es: Los billetes se emiten en denominaciones de P10, 20, 50, 100 y 200.
money.quote: Banknotes of Botswana are issued in denominations of P10, 20, 50, 100 and 200

connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de Botsuana es +267.

connectivity.en: As of 2022 the government is working on installing free public WiFi in shopping malls and several government facilities.
connectivity.es: En 2022 el gobierno trabaja en instalar wifi público gratuito en centros comerciales y varias instalaciones gubernamentales.
connectivity.quote: As of 2022 the government is working on installing free public WiFi in shopping malls and several government owned facilities

connectivity.es: Las bibliotecas también tienen wifi gratuito.

connectivity.en: Mobile data runs at 4G speed in and around the big cities and 3G or even 2G in very rural areas.
connectivity.es: Los datos móviles van a velocidad 4G en y alrededor de las grandes ciudades y a 3G o incluso 2G en zonas muy rurales.
connectivity.quote: (4G speed in and around the big cities and 3G and even 2G speed in very rural areas)
